en.purpose: To provide a prognostic grading system for clear cell renal cell carcinoma based on the Fuhrman nuclear grade, using tumor cell morphological features.
en.use:
Use to provide a prognostic grading system for clear cell renal cell carcinoma based on the Fuhrman nuclear grade, using tumor cell morphological features. 

The Fuhrman's nuclear grading is based on:
- Nuclear size
- Nuclear shape
- Nucleoli
- Bizzarely shaped nuclei
en.misuse: Not to be used to record information related to other renal tumor grading systems, or for general histopathology findings not specific to Fuhrman nuclear grading.

other_details.en: The Fuhrman Nuclear Grade classification is used for determining the histological severity of clear cell renal cell carcinoma, where the grade is assigned based on nuclear diameter, shape, and nucleolar prominence.

gt0001.text: Fuhrman Nuclear Grade for Clear Cell Renal Carcinoma
gt0001.description: The Fuhrman Nuclear Grade is a histopathological classification system used to stratify the severity of clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC). It assesses nuclear features across three criteria: size, shape, and nucleolar prominence, and assigns a grade from 1 to 4 based on the most severe observed feature.

gt0009.description: Similar to normal kidney cells and have small, round nuclei with inconspicuous nucleoli.

gt0022.text: Bizarre often multilobed nuclei and/or spindle cells

gt0025.description: Extremely large and bizarrely shaped nuclei and prominent nucleoli.

gt0026.description: Slightly larger nuclei with irregular outlines and more visible nucleoli.

gt0027.description: Larger nuclei, more irregular outlines, and more prominent nucleoli.
